fields.statement: Model events run your scripts: the daemon runs an owner-configured command once for each change set proposed, accepted, rejected, withdrawn, landed or reopened, including transitions pulled from other clones

fields.quote: if you run out of work keep picking high value tasks. don't stop and wait for my input.
fields.statement: Milestone 17 carves hooks and model-event-hooks out of the Area hooks umbrella and builds lifecycle event hooks in the daemon; hook-commands and custom-kinds stay in the umbrella, and drift events wait for Area integrity

The daemon, each poll, runs the event command (--event-command, or else git config rhiza.eventCommand) through sh -c in the repo root once per lifecycle move it has not handled, in log order, with the move as JSON on stdin and RHIZA_EVENT, RHIZA_EVENT_CHANGE, RHIZA_EVENT_ENTRY and RHIZA_EVENT_TITLE set; it records handled entry IDs in its state, seeding every existing move on first run so history is not replayed; a failing or timed-out (10 s) command is logged and not retried
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)
